meta.title: A live RFQ: "Withdrawing Order...": "Yes" with the fields as they open is refused

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ as the buyer.
Open the Responses tab before accessing Settings.
Open the withdrawal window and confirm without entering a reason to test the required-remark refusal.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Verify the required withdrawal reason message remains visible and nothing was saved.
